use_case_summary: Primary: agent-assist for clinical contact center (real-time suggestions, golden-reply, Q/A). Secondary: ticket summarization (multi-message -> concise notes), automated tool-calls to EHR for order creation and status checks. Needs structured function/tool calling with strict allowlists, deterministic outputs for audit. Latency target: median <300ms gen for single-turn suggestions; p95 <2s during typical day; must sustain spikes up to 1000 rps in failover path. Model preferences: high-quality open models, quantized where safe. Routing/fallback: prefer private -> dedicated fallback; no public-hosted fallback unless in isolated region and contractually cleared. Metrics: per-token costs visible, token retention zero by default, audit logs for every API call, KMS-wrapped keys for encryption at rest.
